title: Make E2E-1108 in infra_p1_test.dart exercise the real ReminderEnabled notifier instead of round-tripping SharedPreferences
rule: TQ-8 (tautological / weaker than the failure modes of the code under test)

evidence.quote: group('E2E-1108 — Per-profile notification prefs isolated on profile switch', () {

why: The test titled 'Per-profile notification prefs isolated on profile switch' never switches the active profile and never instantiates the real ReminderEnabled Riverpod notifier — it calls prefs.setBool(keyB, false) and then asserts prefs.getBool(keyB) is false, which only proves the SharedPreferences mock stores what it was told (an SDK behavior, not app logic). reminderEnabledKey() is a one-line string formatter (base + profileId). A real regression this journey is meant to catch — e.g. ReminderEnabled.build() caching profile A's value after activeProfileIdProvider flips to B, or the notifier writing under the wrong profile's key — would not be caught here because the notifier is never built or read through ref. The in-file comment even concedes 'provider rebuilds on activeProfileIdProvider are covered by the widget itself' without pointing to where.
recommendation: Drive the real flow: mount /notifications for profile A, toggle the reminder switch, then swap the active identity (second E2EHarness or an activeProfileIdProvider override simulating profile B) and assert the widget/notifier reflects B's independently-loaded state, not just that two SharedPreferences keys hold different bytes.
acceptance_criteria: E2E-1108 fails red if ReminderEnabled.build() is changed to ignore activeProfileIdProvider and read a single shared key.
Test reads the reminder toggle state through the widget tree (not direct SharedPreferences access) for at least one of the two profiles.

corrections: test/features/notifications/presentation/providers/reminder_enabled_cold_start_test.dart K4 ('Mid-session profile switch', lines 201-238) already drives the real ReminderEnabled notifier through activeProfileIdProvider 1->2 via a real overrideWith notifier and asserts isolated per-profile values load correctly — the exact caching/isolation regression the finding claims is uncatchable. Remaining gap is narrower: no test reads the toggle through the widget tree.
